Blueprint Code AI prototype

A rapid proof of concept

This rough interactive demo was created to show how a clearer bracelet-building experience could work before committing to production design and development.

  • Persistent live product preview
  • Flexible piece selection and rearrangement
  • Capacity, compatibility and engraving rules
  • Itemised pricing and a Shopify-ready order structure

The jewellery assets, attachment positions, branding and product rules are illustrative. A production version would use the client’s supplied catalogue and artwork, refined rendering, full mobile testing and live Shopify integration.
